name: Vera Blanc and the Purloined Patient
source:
Vera Blanc and Brandon Mackey, private investigators who specialize in solving "unusual" cases, are asked to investigate the mysterious disappearance of Francine ("Frankie") Steen from her hospital bed. She was diagnosed as brain-dead and on life support at the time, as a result of an automobile accident. Since she was incapable of leaving on her own, someone else obviously engineered her disappearance.
Who kidnapped her, and why?
Was it Francine's father?
Was it her boyfriend?
Was it the hospital security guard?
Was it the night nurse?
Was it the doctor?
You, the player, guide Vera and Brandon through the story. Help them investigate, ask questions, interview the other characters, and use Vera's ability to (sometimes) read minds in order to solve the mystery.
Player choices determine how the story progresses, and the eventual outcome. There are three endings. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20801]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
维拉·布兰克（Vera Blanc）和布兰登·麦基（Brandon Mackey）是专门解决“不寻常”案件的私家侦探，他们被要求调查弗朗辛（“弗兰基”）·斯蒂恩在医院病床上的神秘失踪事件。由于一场车祸，她被诊断为脑死亡，当时需要生命维持系统。由于她无法自行离开，显然是有人策划了她的失踪。
谁绑架了她，为什么？
是弗朗辛的父亲吗？
是她男朋友吗？
是医院的保安吗？
是夜班护士吗？
是医生吗？
你，作为玩家，引导维拉和布兰登完成故事。帮助他们调查、提出问题、采访其他角色，并利用维拉（有时）读心的能力来解开谜团。
玩家的选择决定了故事的进展以及最终的结果。共有三个结局。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20801]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
